Today was their second lotto 6 6 6, where they raffle off truly just a handful of tickets for sixty six dollars and sixty cents. But the odds of winning were still pretty slim. So I went there mostly just to capture content and then I was gonna head home. But then, what do you know? They're calling numbers and the last ticket pulled is my ticket. There were only 10 winners and I was No. 10. And I did not have any time to go home and change because our show was in an hour. Despite the fact that I was dressed like this, which if you've seen masquerade, is a bit of a no no. They encourage you to dress up. The last few times I went, I was in a full tux. But again, I did not think I was gonna win. So I was like, no point in getting all dressed up just to go to the lottery and then go home. So shame on me. But thankfully it was not an issue. They actually gave me one of the infamous cloaks Which I did kind of insist on because I really wanted to wear a cloak. And let me tell you, it was very fun. I think that we should bring cloaks back. But the show was really special because if you don't know, today is Hugh Panaro's last day in the show. He was one of the longest running phantoms on Broadway. He did the show like 2000+ times, and he also opened masquerade last fall as one of the Phantoms. He is a true legend, and I was actually really sad that I was not gonna get a chance to see him. But as luck would have it, I got to be there for his final matinee in. And that was just so special. Our Christine was Francesca Marotta, who I also have not gotten a chance to see yet. Her voice is just stunning. And I actually got a letter from her in the dressing room scene, which was really special. I'm also really glad I got to go back one last time, because from what I hear, they are downsizing the show starting next week. I was really glad I had just one more time to go through and get the full experience. I've been lucky enough to see the show four times now, and it really is a completely different experience every single time I go back. But this one today was. Was really special.
